one_line: A minimalist top-down arena game where your decaying trail is the weapon; neon actors on a near-black field.
camera: strict top-down / orthographic, no perspective, no cast shadows
mood: cool, tense, focused; the background recedes so gameplay elements pop
palette_notes: Enemy TYPE is read by colour — colour coding is load-bearing gameplay, not decoration. Generated actors must snap to these exact hexes.
negatives: no busy focal points in backgrounds
notes: Actors render at ~20-26px in the current prototype; the final game may scale these up. Keep silhouettes readable at small sizes — strong single-colour shapes over fine detail.
